Basis for Intervening:
DOC-LESS INTERVENTION
Pursuant to Rule 214(a)(2) of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission), 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(a)(2) (2025), the Council of the City of New Orleans, Louisiana (Council) respectfully submits this Notice of Intervention.

Pursuant to the Home Rule Charter of the City of New Orleans, the Council regulates the rates, terms and conditions for retail utility service provided in New Orleans by Entergy New Orleans, LLC (ENO), an Entergy Operating Company.  The retail rates of ENO may be affected by the Commission’s decision in this proceeding.  As such, the Council has substantial, direct interests that may be affected by the outcome of this proceeding.  The Commission has routinely treated the Council as a State Commission for the purposes of Rule 214(a)(2).  See, e.g., Entergy-Koch Trading, L.P., 99 FERC ¶ 61,027, at 61,107 (2002); Entergy Nuclear Generation Co., 88 FERC ¶ 62,026, at 64,051 (1999); Southern Natural Gas Co., 51 FERC ¶ 61,186, at 61,505 (1990).  Accordingly, the Council is entitled to intervene as a matter of right pursuant to this timely filing of notice.  Wherefore, the Council respectfully gives notice of its intervention in this proceeding.
